title: Trail shoe · turntable
prompt: The trail running shoe rotates slowly on a white studio turntable, showing its side, toe and heel, soft studio light with a gentle rim light.

title: Trail shoe · clay to colour
prompt: The grey clay model of the shoe slowly takes on its materials and colours, spreading from heel to toe, until it is the finished green and sand shoe.

title: Trail shoe · sunrise on the trail
prompt: Mist drifts through the valley below as the sunrise light grows warmer on the rocks and the shoe; a light breeze moves the heather.

title: EV crossover · rain in the city
prompt: Light rain falls on the wet street, neon signs flicker and their reflections ripple on the car and the asphalt.

title: Rain shell · first raindrops
prompt: The model looks up as the first raindrops fall, pulls the hood of the orange jacket up and smiles; the fabric creases naturally.

title: Desert scavenger · idle
prompt: The desert scavenger stands breathing slowly, shifting his weight; the cloth wraps flutter in a warm wind and fine dust drifts past.

title: Lighthouse keeper · the storm
prompt: Lightning flashes over the black sea, rain lashes the cottage and the keeper steps back from the doorway as the lighthouse beam sweeps through the storm.
